title: Order to Establish the Humbug Landscape Unit and Objectives, 1 August 2003
madeUnder: Forest Practices Code Act s. 4(1) and (2); continued as a Land Act s. 93.4 objective by Land Act s. 93.8
transcribedFrom: signed PDF, text layer checked against the pages

provisions.heading: Humbug landscape unit established
quotes: Pursuant to section 4 (1) of the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act (the Act)

provisions.heading: Humbug: old growth distribution through OGMAs
quotes: by maintaining the old growth management areas (OGMAs) as shown on Map 3
Meet the distribution of old growth for each Landscape Unit / Biogeoclimatic Unit

provisions.heading: Humbug: maintain the mapped OGMAs
quotes: Maintain old growth management areas, which are established as shown on the attached Map 3.

provisions.heading: Humbug: cutting in OGMAs only for insect or disease control
quotes: Cutting trees within OGMAs, is limited to circumstances where it is absolutely necessary for insect or disease infestation
When intervention in OGMAs is required because of a forest health threat to adjacent areas

provisions.heading: Humbug: permanent and temporary roads in OGMAs only without a practicable option
quotes: Permanent roads may be constructed and maintained in OGMAs where there are no other practicable options.
Temporary roads may also be constructed in OGMAs where there are no other practicable options.
Any temporary roads that are built in OGMAs must be deactivated, rehabilitated and planted as soon as possible.

provisions.heading: Humbug: fire suppression in OGMAs
quotes: Fire suppression is permitted within OGMAs for the purposes of maintaining the integrity of the OGMAs.

provisions.heading: Forest development plans consistent with the order
quotes: Pursuant to Section 10 (1) (d) (ii) of the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act

provisions.heading: Effective date
quotes: Effective Date of Order This Order takes effect on August 1, 2003.
